intro: Return to Valanaar is a quest where an adventurer delivers Yorna's report regarding the defense of the eastern watchtower back to Valennia Stormfist in Valanaar. The report confirms that the perimeter has been stabilized and the remaining attackers are being cleared out, bringing welcome relief to the settlement's leadership.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I suspect it will take a bit of time for us to mop up what's left of the attackers, but our chances are far better now. Head back to Valanaar and let them know that we are stable here now.
I can't thank you enough for your help. We'd be in much worse shape without you. I asked for reinforcements and it seems that I got a burgeoning hero instead. I'll take that.
May the four winds bless you, adventurer.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Valennia looks visibly relieved as you tell her about the status of the eastern watchtower.
